description: List, test and extract files from ZIP archives with Info-ZIP UnZip.

tip: allow archive members to be extracted outside the current directory
(Acorn only) use the given extension list
(Unix) allow control characters in extracted names
(DOS/OS2/NT) restore the volume label if the medium is removable
(DOS/OS2/NT) restore the volume label on fixed media too
(zipinfo mode) list names only, one per line
(VMS only) convert names unconditionally to ODS-compatible names
(zipinfo mode) list names only, with headers, trailers and comments

option.name: -a
tip: convert text files to the local OS format

option.name: -A
tip: (OS/2 and Unix DLL builds) print extended help for the DLL

option.name: -b
tip: treat all files as binary

option.name: -B
tip: (when built with UNIXBACKUP) save a backup of each overwritten file

option.name: -c
tip: extract files to standard output, with their names

option.name: -C
tip: match archive names case-insensitively

option.name: -d
tip: extract files into the given directory

option.name: -D
tip: do not restore timestamps for extracted directories

option.name: -DD
tip: do not restore timestamps for any entry

option.name: -E
tip: (classic Mac OS only) display the MacOS extra field while restoring

option.name: -f
tip: freshen existing files only; create none

option.name: -F
tip: (Acorn only) control NFS filetype extension handling

option.name: -h
tip: show help
(zipinfo mode) list the header line

option.name: -hh
tip: show extended help

option.name: -i
tip: include only files matching the patterns
(classic Mac OS builds use -i without a value to ignore MacOS extra-field names)

option.name: -I
tip: (Unix) set the character encoding for UNIX and other archives

option.name: -j
tip: junk paths and extract all files into the current directory

option.name: -J
tip: (BeOS) junk file attributes; (classic Mac OS) ignore MacOS-specific information

option.name: -K
tip: restore SUID, SGID and sticky permissions

option.name: -l
tip: list files using the short format
(zipinfo mode) list in long Unix ls -l format

option.name: -L
tip: lowercase names that came from an uppercase-only file system

option.name: -LL
tip: lowercase all names

option.name: -m
tip: (zipinfo mode) list in long Unix ls -l format with compression percentage

option.name: -M
tip: pipe output through the internal pager

option.name: -n
tip: never overwrite existing files

option.name: -N
tip: (Amiga only) extract file comments as Amiga file notes

option.name: -o
tip: overwrite existing files without prompting

option.name: -O
tip: (Unix) set the character encoding for DOS, Windows and OS/2 archives

option.name: -p
tip: extract files to standard output without messages

option.name: -P
tip: use the given password to decrypt files
the password is visible to other users on some systems

option.name: -q
tip: quiet operation; repeat for less output

option.name: -s
tip: (OS/2, NT, DOS) convert spaces in names to underscores
(zipinfo mode) list in short Unix ls -l format

option.name: -S
tip: (VMS only) convert text files to Stream_LF format

option.name: -t
tip: test the archive
(zipinfo mode) list totals for the files

option.name: -T
tip: set the archive timestamp to that of its newest file
(zipinfo mode) print dates as yymmdd.hhmmss

option.name: -u
tip: update older files on disk and extract new files

option.name: -U
tip: show non-local characters as #Uxxxx or #Lxxxxxx escapes

option.name: -UU
tip: disable stored UTF-8 path information

option.name: -v
tip: use verbose listing; `unzip -v` alone shows version information
(zipinfo mode) list verbose multi-page information

option.name: -V
tip: (VMS only) retain VMS file version numbers

option.name: -W
tip: (when built with WILD_STOP_AT_DIR) make ? and * stop at directory separators

option.name: -x
tip: exclude files matching the patterns

option.name: -X
tip: restore UIDs/GIDs (Unix), ACLs (VMS/OS2) or security ACLs (Windows NT)

option.name: -XX
tip: (Windows NT only) extract NT security ACLs

option.name: -Y
tip: (VMS only) treat .nnn name endings as VMS version numbers

option.name: -z
tip: display only the archive comment
(zipinfo mode) include the archive comment in the listing

option.name: -Z
tip: switch to zipinfo mode; must be the first option
